matches.rationale: GT1 concerns conflicting assumptions about data distribution (heavy-tailed vs sub-Gaussian, unbounded vs bounded covariance spectrum). None of the findings address data distribution assumptions or covariance properties; they focus on score distance definitions, timescale formulas, and memorization criteria instead.

GT2 concerns the oversimplified equation L_gen = L_test - L_train for generalization loss. None of the findings discuss generalization loss, the train-test gap, or overfitting metrics; they address different methodological issues (score distance, timescales, memorization).

pred_verdicts.rationale: Valid observation that E_score measures distance to clean-data score rather than noised score P_t, but not in ground truth.
Valid observation about dimensional inconsistency in the timescale relation (time vs rate), but not in ground truth.
Valid observation about incorrect expectation notation in the memorization criterion for single samples, but not in ground truth.
